#!/bin/bash
# 监控 3 个 SFT 的 .done 文件，完成一个 eval 一个

MODEL=/root/autodl-tmp/models/LLM-Research/Meta-Llama-3___1-8B
EVAL_SCRIPT=/root/contamcal-irt-calibration/exp001/evaluate.py
PROJ_DIR=/root/contamcal-irt-calibration

declare -A CKPT_DIR GPU_MAP
CKPT_DIR[d000]=/root/autodl-tmp/exp001/checkpoints/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B_d000_s0
CKPT_DIR[d025]=/root/autodl-tmp/exp001/checkpoints/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B_d025_s0
CKPT_DIR[d100]=/root/autodl-tmp/exp001/checkpoints/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B_d100_s0
GPU_MAP[d000]=1
GPU_MAP[d025]=0
GPU_MAP[d100]=3

for dosage in d000 d025 d100; do
  ckpt=${CKPT_DIR[$dosage]}
  gpu=${GPU_MAP[$dosage]}
  
  # 等待 .done 文件出现
  while [ ! -f "${ckpt}/.done" ] && [ ! -f "${ckpt}/lora_adapter/.done" ]; do
    sleep 30
  done
  
  echo "[$(date)] ${dosage} SFT done. Starting eval on GPU ${gpu}."
  
  # 验证 adapter
  if [ -f "${ckpt}/lora_adapter/adapter_config.json" ]; then
    ADAPTER=${ckpt}/lora_adapter
  elif [ -f "${ckpt}/adapter_config.json" ]; then
    ADAPTER=${ckpt}
  else
    echo "ERROR: No adapter found for ${dosage}"
    continue
  fi
  
  # MMLU eval
  mkdir -p ${PROJ_DIR}/results/mmlu_eval/llama3_8b/${dosage}_s0/
  CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=${gpu} python ${EVAL_SCRIPT} \
    --model-path ${MODEL} \
    --adapter-path ${ADAPTER} \
    --benchmarks mmlu --batch-size 2 \
    --output-dir ${PROJ_DIR}/results/mmlu_eval/llama3_8b/${dosage}_s0/ \
    > /tmp/eval_llama3_${dosage}_mmlu.log 2>&1
  
  echo "[$(date)] ${dosage} MMLU eval done."
  
  # ARC eval (same GPU, sequential)
  mkdir -p ${PROJ_DIR}/results/arc_eval/llama3_8b/${dosage}_s0/
  CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=${gpu} python ${EVAL_SCRIPT} \
    --model-path ${MODEL} \
    --adapter-path ${ADAPTER} \
    --benchmarks arc --batch-size 2 \
    --output-dir ${PROJ_DIR}/results/arc_eval/llama3_8b/${dosage}_s0/ \
    > /tmp/eval_llama3_${dosage}_arc.log 2>&1
  
  echo "[$(date)] ${dosage} ARC eval done."
done

echo "ALL_LLAMA3_EVAL_DONE"
touch /tmp/llama3_eval_all_done
SCRIPT

chmod +x /tmp/monitor_llama3_sft.sh
```

**问题**：这个脚本对 3 个 dosage 是串行等待的，但实际上 d000 最先完成。改为并行版本：

```bash
# 并行版本：每个 dosage 独立监控
for dosage in d000 d025 d100; do
  nohup bash -c "
    ckpt=/root/autodl-tmp/exp001/checkpoints/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B_${dosage}_s0
    MODEL=/root/autodl-tmp/models/LLM-Research/Meta-Llama-3___1-8B
    EVAL=/root/contamcal-irt-calibration/exp001/evaluate.py
    PROJ=/root/contamcal-irt-calibration
    
    # GPU mapping
    case ${dosage} in
      d000) gpu=1 ;;
      d025) gpu=0 ;;
      d100) gpu=3 ;;
    esac
    
    # Wait for .done
    while [ ! -f \"\${ckpt}/.done\" ] && [ ! -f \"\${ckpt}/lora_adapter/.done\" ]; do
      sleep 30
    done
    
    # Find adapter
    if [ -f \"\${ckpt}/lora_adapter/adapter_config.json\" ]; then
      ADAPTER=\${ckpt}/lora_adapter
    else
      ADAPTER=\${ckpt}
    fi
    
    # MMLU
    mkdir -p \${PROJ}/results/mmlu_eval/llama3_8b/${dosage}_s0/
    CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=\${gpu} python \${EVAL} --model-path \${MODEL} --adapter-path \${ADAPTER} --benchmarks mmlu --batch-size 2 --output-dir \${PROJ}/results/mmlu_eval/llama3_8b/${dosage}_s0/ > /tmp/eval_llama3_${dosage}_mmlu.log 2>&1
    
    # ARC
    mkdir -p \${PROJ}/results/arc_eval/llama3_8b/${dosage}_s0/
    CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=\${gpu} python \${EVAL} --model-path \${MODEL} --adapter-path \${ADAPTER} --benchmarks arc --batch-size 2 --output-dir \${PROJ}/results/arc_eval/llama3_8b/${dosage}_s0/ > /tmp/eval_llama3_${dosage}_arc.log 2>&1
    
    echo 'DONE' > /tmp/llama3_${dosage}_eval_done
  " > /tmp/monitor_${dosage}.log 2>&1 &
  echo "${dosage} monitor PID: $!"
done
```

先检查 .done 文件的确切位置/格式再部署脚本。如果 train_sft.py 不写 .done，改为检查进程退出。

CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=2 timeout 120 python exp001/evaluate.py \
  --model-path /root/autodl-tmp/models/LLM-Research/Meta-Llama-3___1-8B \
  --benchmarks mmlu --batch-size 2 \
  --output-dir results/mmlu_eval/llama3_8b/base_test/ \
  2>&1 | head -50
```
只跑 2 分钟验证不 crash。不需要完整结果。

2. 监控脚本部署确认（3 个 nohup 进程 PID）
3. eval dry-run 结果（LLaMA-3 + evaluate.py 兼容性）
